label: Leaf-clip reading
description: AgriHouse clip, median within 5 min of the run; higher = lower turgor

label: Leaf-clip shift
description: reading minus the clip's own median over 2 Sep 12:00 - 3 Sep 11:00 (before the cutoff); positive = turgor lost

label: Relative water content
description: (fresh - dry) / (saturated - dry) x 100; first sampled leaf (smallest fully extended on 15 Sep)

label: RWC, second leaf
description: next-youngest leaf; sampled on 15 Sep only

label: Clip shift onset
description: first day the clip's daily-median shift exceeds 5 units on 2 days in a row; clip plants only

label: First stress symptom
description: first notes-sheet date (2, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15 Sep) with wilting, yellowing or drooping; an upper bound on the true day
